Entry Goldenheart Wood of the Summer Islands The golden heartwood, feathers, spices and longbows of the Summer Islands appear precious and unfamiliar in distant markets. The islanders cherish the gifts of the ocean and forest, and foreign traders often only see the goods; the reputation of a longbow on the battlefield cannot conceal the slow growth of trees. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.
